items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We just made that album together. We never played any gigs. That was the whole existence of the relationship.

ctx.x: Then another recording, not too long after that – let me scroll down and get that exact date: a recording with Max Roach in Chicago. Could you talk a little bit about that date?

Once again, Max Roach came to town to play the Blue Note in Chicago. The Blue Note to Chicago was like Birdland was to New York. That was the jazz place. There were many, but that was head of the class. It was after the accident.
I’m showing January 4th, 1958. The accident was in ’56.
